effect_description_eng:
[Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When one of your Digimon with the [Insectoid] or [Ancient Insect] trait deletes an opponent's Digimon in battle and survives, you may unsuspend this Digimon. 
[Your Turn] For each Digimon card with the [Insectoid] trait in this Digimon's digivolution cards, it gets +1000 DP.
